name: strategy-decision-p3b
description: Experiment protocol section 13.23 supplement 2: strategy_decision.json with the report periods derived from the data end (P3 = [2026-07-01, 2026-10-23), P2 = the four quarters before it); rules, thresholds and the increment block are unchanged. Experiment protocol section 13.20 items 5 and 6 plus supplement 1, applied to a scenario_suite_v1_p3 output: the original argmax rule (highest P1+P2 institution net Sharpe on TW at fractional capital among S1, S2 and S-A) is still reported; the amended rule shortlists every cell whose net Sharpe reaches 1.5 in P1, P2 and P1+P2 and whose P1+P2 lower bound is above zero, and reads H-J for each of them (strict 'not deeper' and the 2x multiple). The chip increment at the strategy level is the paired F2 - F0 daily net difference (informational).
